# apicp_mail_settings (Resource)

The mail server's server-wide settings on apicp's control-plane node. Requires an admin-tier provider token. One per server: declare it once. Destroying it puts apicp's default back (`default_max_message_size_mb`); it never leaves the server without a value. Needs apicp after v0.6.18.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The largest message the mail server accepts, incoming and outgoing. One per server.
# 50 MB lets through attachments up to roughly 36 MB (encoding adds about a third).
resource "apicp_mail_settings" "this" {
  max_message_size_mb = 50
}

# Or no limit at all:
#
# resource "apicp_mail_settings" "this" {
#   max_message_size_mb = 0
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `max_message_size_mb` (Number) Largest message the mail server accepts, incoming and outgoing (Postfix `message_size_limit`), in MB (1024 × 1024 bytes). `0` = unlimited, otherwise 1 to 10240. It is the whole message as sent: attachments grow by about a third when encoded, so 50 MB lets through attachments up to roughly 36 MB. A larger message is refused, so its sender gets a bounce.

### Read-Only

- `default_max_message_size_mb` (Number) apicp's own default - what the server has until this is set, and what destroying this resource goes back to.
- `id` (String) Always `mail_settings`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apicp_mail_settings.this mail_settings
```
